candidates.exact_span: Alternative 8 - The percent solids of sewage sludge that contains unstabilized solids generated in a primary wastewater treatment process shall be equal to or greater than 90% based on the moisture content and total solids prior to mixing with other materials.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes an enforceable numeric solids limit (≥90%) whose applicability depends on whether sludge contains unstabilized primary-process solids and on how moisture content and total solids are measured prior to mixing; different readings or classifications change which limit applies and whether a reported solids measurement exceeds it.

candidates.exact_span: Unstabilized solids are defined as organic materials in sewage sludge that have not been treated in either an aerobic or anaerobic treatment process.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines when Alternative 8's 90% solids limit is triggered; different interpretation of whether solids were aerobically or anaerobically treated, or what counts as the treatment process boundary, changes whether the numeric limit is applicable to a given sludge stream.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a permit-life monitoring obligation with a one-year window tied to permit effective date; different interpretations of permit effective date, permit life scope, or whether the one-year window has elapsed change whether TCLP monitoring was required in FY2025 and how to classify absent TCLP results (required-but-missing vs not yet due vs not applicable).
